+
+**Status:** done — all 4 phases implemented and verified (2026-08-14). Server
++client typecheck and full test suites green throughout; manual/browser
+verification done for Phases 2-4 (Phase 1's was deliberately deferred to
+avoid a second billed LLM call — see the Aggregate Verification note below).
+
+## Context
+
+The Intent Layer (`docs/intent-layer-plan.md`, merged to main) shipped a
+real producer for Intent (`intent`, `in_scope`, `out_of_scope`,
+`confidence`, `evidence_tier`, `sources`) via a cheap-model LLM call
+(`server/src/modules/intent/service.ts`), persisted to `pr_intent`, and
+rendered on `IntentCard.tsx`. That plan explicitly deferred "the mockup's
+two-column PR BRIEF + BLAST RADIUS layout" as future work. Separately, the
+just-shipped (unmerged) Smart Diff feature (PR #16) was live-tested on a
+real PR, which surfaced that severity badges/auto-expand work correctly but
+there's no PR-level summary telling a reviewer where the findings are or
+letting them jump to them — motivating one more phase below.

+   findings/blockers count, cost.
+3. **Intent card redesign** — restructure `IntentCard.tsx` toward the
+   mockup's "PR BRIEF" card look (Risk Areas included; Blast Radius is not).
+4. **Findings → Code Changes tab navigation** (separate phase, explicitly
+   requested last) — an optional in-app "view in diff" affordance on a
+   finding, alongside the existing GitHub deep-link, that switches to the
+   Files-changed tab and scrolls to the exact line.

+contract (`server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/brief.ts`, currently pure
+scaffolding — no producer, no consumer) rather than a new simplified type.

+/** Filters each risk's file_refs down to paths that actually appear in the
+ * diff's file list — never trust a raw model-cited path. A risk with no
+ * file_refs to begin with (e.g. "no tests added") always stays valid. A
+ * risk is dropped only when it HAD file_refs and every one failed to
+ * match a real diff file. */
+export function filterRiskFileRefs(
+  risks: RiskDerivation[] | null | undefined,
+  filePaths: string[],
+): Risk[] {
+  if (!risks) return [];
+  const validPaths = new Set(filePaths);
+  const kept: Risk[] = [];
+  for (const r of risks) {
+    if (r.file_refs.length === 0) {
+      kept.push({ ...r, file_refs: [] });
+      continue;
+    }
+    const matched = r.file_refs.filter((f) => validPaths.has(f));
+    if (matched.length === 0) continue;
+    kept.push({ ...r, file_refs: matched });
+  }
+  return kept;
+}
+```

+const VERDICT_PRIORITY: Record<Verdict, number> = {
+  request_changes: 0,
+  comment: 1,
+  approve: 2,
+};
+
+/** Worst verdict across a PR's latest review batch. Non-Verdict garbage
+ * strings (reviews.verdict has no DB CHECK constraint) are silently
+ * ignored, not thrown on. Empty/all-invalid input → null. */
+export function worstVerdict(verdicts: (string | null)[]): Verdict | null {
+  let best: Verdict | null = null;
+  let bestPriority = Infinity;
+  for (const v of verdicts) {
+    if (v !== 'request_changes' && v !== 'comment' && v !== 'approve') continue;
+    const priority = VERDICT_PRIORITY[v];
+    if (priority < bestPriority) { bestPriority = priority; best = v; }
+  }
+  return best;
+}

primary.body:
## Summary

Implements all 6 phases of `docs/smart-diff-plan.md`: a deterministic (no new LLM call), risk-ordered view of a PR's changed files — `core` (business logic) sorted first, `wiring` (config/entrypoints) after, `boilerplate` (lockfiles/generated/vendored) collapsed by default — with findings and per-line severity badges once a review has run, a one-sentence per-file summary piggybacked on the existing Run Review call, and a real split-suggestion banner built from `repo-intel`'s already-indexed import graph.

- **Phase 1** — `classifyFile()`: path/size-based classifier, multi-language patterns (JS/TS/Go/Rust/Python), reusing `repo-intel`'s `EXCLUDED_DIRS`.
- **Phase 2** — `GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff`: composes classified files with the latest review batch's findings (contract grows `finding_lines: {line,severity}[]` + `findings_count`).
- **Phase 3** — `SmartDiffViewer`: grouped, collapsible sections; clickable "N findings" badge that scrolls to and highlights the right line.
- **Phase 4** — wires `SmartDiffViewer` into `DiffTab` behind a real "Smart order"/"Original order" segmented toggle, falling back to the flat `DiffViewer` if smart-diff has no data.
- **Phase 5** — `pseudocode_summary`: the existing Run Review LLM call now also emits a one-line `file_summaries` entry per file (new `review_file_summaries` table); rendered as a header Chip + "What this does:" text.
- **Phase 6** — real `split_suggestion`: weakly-connected-components clustering over the PR's changed `core` files via a new `RepoIntel.getFileEdges` port method; a banner with click-to-highlight, no LLM.

Every phase was implemented by a subagent and then independently re-verified (typecheck, full test suites, real Postgres, and for Phase 2/4/6 a live running server) rather than trusted from its own report — see `docs/smart-diff-plan.md`'s Status section for the phase-by-phase detail and two corrections made during that review (a duplicate-path render fix in Phase 3, and a repo-intel-unindexed edge case fixed in Phase 6).

**Known, deliberately unfixed finding** (see plan doc): `vendor/shared/contracts/*.ts` files misclassify as `boilerplate` because Phase 1 reuses `repo-intel`'s generic `vendor` exclusion (meant for Go's real vendored-dependency convention), which collides with this repo's own unrelated `vendor/shared` hand-copy convention. Flagged for a follow-up decision, not patched here.

## Test plan

- [x] Server: typecheck clean; unit 309/309; full integration 71/71 (incl. new `smart-diff-split.test.ts`, extended `smart-diff-service.it.test.ts`)
- [x] Client: typecheck clean; full suite 145/145 (incl. new `SmartDiffViewer.test.tsx`, `DiffTab.test.tsx`)
- [x] Migration `0023_icy_photon.sql` applied to local Postgres, table/index confirmed via `psql`
- [x] Live-verified end to end against real PRs on a running dev server (Phase 2's route directly, Phase 4/6's UI in-browser: toggle, grouping, collapse/expand, split banner)
- [ ] `pr-self-review` — running now (full mode)
